Priya: Morning — quick handoff from me, I'm off at 9:30 PT. TL;DR: no active incidents, two things to watch, one action item (below).
Priya: Watchlist: 1) embed-service tail latency has small p95 blips after the 03:00 deploy (see grafana link) — they've stayed <120ms but jumped briefly to ~210ms twice. 2) Dedicated pool `dedicated-east-1-a` is draining nodes for a maintenance window today at 14:00 UTC (autoscaler will rebalance).
Priya: Action item: If you see embed p95 >200ms for >5m, flip traffic to embed-v2 canary: /rollout embed-service canary 20% (or run the manual scale below). I'll leave the canary config in the runbook.
Avi: Thanks — noted. Which grafana panel? Send the short link?
Priya: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/embed-latency?panelId=7 — panel titled "embed-service p95 by pod". Pinged SLO alert 3 (threshold 180ms) is currently DISABLED for noise; we didn't enable it after the last tuning.
Sam: Quick FYI — I left a small change in the k8s HPA for embed-v2 (lower cooldown to 60s). Might help on spikes but could increase churn. I added a comment in the PR: #4521.
Tomas: Re: draining nodes — heads up for any long-running legacy batch jobs. I scheduled a short window to complete them by 13:50 UTC; if they overrun, I'll abort and requeue.
Priya: Good call. If you see OOMs or pod evictions in inference-prod during the drain, try scale-to-4 on embed-svc until nodes finish:
```
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deployment/embed-service --replicas=4
```
Avi: deploy-bot just reported a rolling restart started for config-service in prod at 08:12 PT — not related but FYI.
deploy-bot: [bot] rollout config-service prod starting (rollout/1234) — staged restarts, no schema changes.
Sam: I'll keep an eye on costs for dedicated pool during the scale; if it spikes >10% hour-over-hour I'll slack finance-alerts.
Priya: One more note: small infra ticket to watch: INF-3092 (kv cache eviction threshold tuned yesterday). We shouldn't see functional impact, but cache miss rate might tick up slightly for long-tail keys.
Tomas: Oncall swap: I'm covering 09:30–15:30 PT. Priya, enjoy your afternoon.
Priya: Thanks — leaving runbook links and the canary rollback command in the thread. Quick rollback command for canary: `redwoodctl rollout embed-service rollback --to previous`
Avi: Got it. If I see sustained p95 >220ms I'll trigger the canary and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
Sam: ack. Adding a note to the mid-day handoff doc.
Priya: End of notes. Leave any follow-ups here or DM me if you need details.
